p: kindness of thy youth: According to that grace and favour which I showed you from the beginning, when I first chose you to be my people, and married you to myself, Eze 16:8.
in a land that was not: When I had delivered you out of Egypt.
holiness to the LORD: Chosen above all others to serve the Lord only and the first offered to the Lord of all other nations.
that devour him shall offend: Whoever challenged this people, or else annoyed them, was punished.
far from me: That is, fallen to vile idolatry.
vain: Altogether given to vanity, and are become blind and insensible as the idols that they serve.
the shadow of death: Where for lack of all things needed for life, you could look for nothing every hour but present death.
my land: By your idolatry and wicked manners, Ps 78:58,106:38.
Where is the LORD: They did not teach the people to seek after God.
law knew me not: As the scribes, who would have expounded the law to the people.
rulers also transgressed against me: Meaning, the princes and ministers: signifying, that all estates were corrupt.
Baal: That is, spoke vain things, and brought the people from the true worship of God to serve idols: for by Baal, which was the chief idol of the Moabites, are meant all idols.
plead with you: Signifying that he would not as he might, straightway condemn them, but shows them by evident examples their great ingratitude that they might be ashamed and repent.
Chittim: Meaning, the Grecians and Italians.
Kedar: To Arabia.

glory for that which doth not: That is, God who is their glory, and who makes them glorious above all other people, reproving the Jews that they were less diligent to serve the true God, than were the idolaters to honour their vanities.
profit: Meaning the idols who were their destruction, Ps 106:36.
heavens: He shows that the insensible creatures abhor this vile ingratitude, and as it were tremble for fear of God's great judgments against the same.

the fountain of living waters: Signifying that when men forsake God's word, which is the fountain of life, they reject God himself, and so fall to their own inventions, and vain confidence, and procure to themselves destruction, Jon 2:8, Zec 10:2.
servant: Have I ordered them like servants and not like dearly beloved children? Ex 4:22 therefore it is their fault only, if the enemy spoil them.
lions roared upon him: The Babylonians, Chaldeans, and Assyrians.
inhabitant: Not one will be left to dwell there.
Noph and Tahapanes have: That is, the Egyptians, for these were two great cities in Egypt.
broken the crown of thy head: Have grievously vexed you at various times.
led thee by the way: Showing that God would have still led them correctly, if they would have followed him.
Egypt: To seek help from man, as though God was not able enough to defend you, which is to drink from the puddles and to leave the fountain, Isa 31:1.
river: That is, Euphrates.
correct thee: Meaning, that the wicked are insensible, till the punishment for their sin waken them as in Jer 2:26, Isa 3:9.
I will not transgress: When I delivered you out of Egypt, Ex 19:8, De 5:27, Jos 24:16, Ezr 10:12, He 8:6.
lye: Though you use all the purifications and ceremonies of the law, you cannot escape punishment.
gone after Baalim: Meaning that hypocrites deny that they worship the idols, but that they honour God in them, and therefore they call their doings God's service.
dromedary traversing her ways: He compares the idolaters to these beasts, because they never cease running to and fro: for both valleys and hills are full of their idolatry.
donkey used to the wilderness: He compares the idolaters to a wild ass: for she can never be tamed nor yet wearied: for as she runs she can take her wind at every opportunity.

month they shall find her: That is, when she is with foal, and therefore the hunters wait their time: so though you cannot be turned back now from your idolatry, yet when your iniquity will be at the fall, God will meet with you.

being unshod: By this he warns them that they should not go into strange countries to seek help: for they should but spend their labour, and hurt themselves, which is here meant by the bare foot and thirst, Isa 57:10.

thief is ashamed when he is: As a thief will not acknowledge his fault, till he is taken with the deed, and ready to be punished, so they will not confess their idolatry, till the plagues due to the same light on them.
father: Meaning, that idolaters rob God of his honour: and where as he has taught to call him the father of all flesh, they attribute this title to their idols.

to the number of thy cities: You thought that your gods of blocks and stones could have helped you, because they were many in number and present in every place: but now let us see whether either the multitude or their presence can deliver you from my plague, Jer 11:13.
ye plead with me: As though I did you injury in punishing you, seeing that your faults are so evident.
own sword hath devoured your prophets: That is, you have killed your prophets, that exhorted you to repentance, as Zechariah, Isaiah, etc.
wilderness to Israel: Have I not given them abundance of all things?
we will come no more to: But will trust in our own power and policy.
seek love: With strangers.
skirts is found the blood of: The prophets and the faithful are slain in every corner of your country.

as thou wast ashamed of Assyria: For the Assyrians had taken away the ten tribes out of Israel and destroyed Judah even to Jerusalem: and the Egyptians slew Josiah, and vexed the Jews in various ways.
thy head: In sign of lamentation, as in 2Sa 13:19.
